model.title: Providing for the condemnation and denouncement of socialism in all its forms, and for other purposes.
model.meta: Financial Services Committee, House Administration · Rep. Jeff Crank (R-CO)

summary.lead: Official summary (Congressional Research Service, Introduced in House):

blocks.text: This resolution states that the House of Representatives
condemns and denounces socialism in all its forms, including the Democratic Socialists of America, and opposes the implementation of socialist policies in the United States;
reaffirms its support for free, fair, and secure elections and calls for enactment of the SAVE America Act;
reiterates that American elections are for American citizens only; and
recommits itself to upholding the U.S. Constitution.
